items.en: «Минус еще один: «Герань» только что разнесла вертолёт Ми-24 на аэродроме Миргород» (Rybar: 'One more down: a Geran has just destroyed an Mi-24 helicopter at Myrhorod airfield')
items.nl: Rybar: Geran-drone zou Oekraïense Mi-24-helikopter op vliegbasis Myrhorod hebben vernietigd
items.sEn: The Russian milblogger channel Rybar claims that a Geran one-way attack drone (the Russian-produced Shahed derivative) has destroyed a Ukrainian Mi-24 attack helicopter at Myrhorod airfield (Poltava oblast). Rybar presents this as further evidence of losses in Ukraine's aviation and recalls that a Russian Iskander str…
